description: POST action=upload_slip — the uploaded file's MIME type is not in the allowed set (['image/jpeg','image/png','image/gif','image/webp']) — here a PDF. Rejected before the order_id is even looked up against the DB (validation order per L1741-1766: order_id presence -> file presence -> MIME -> size -> DB lookup), so no payment_slips row is written and no notify functions run.
